implemented: Local generated illustration validation and attachment require registered upload.generationJobId plus an exact completed generation-job output uploadId, URL and SHA-256 match. Scene/slot generationJobId must match. Forged or missing identities fail closed.

Generation provenance does not create mediaRights records or infer model-license clearance. Existing explicit generated rights metadata is retained where present. Registered generated uploads cannot be reclassified as own or third-party to become factual event evidence.

Rights decisions, attachment and source-bearing local validation hash actual contained regular files in incremental 64 KiB chunks, reject symlinks/path escapes/non-files/missing or empty files, bound content to 100 MiB, and check file identity/size/timestamps around the read.
Per-validation-call asset cache avoids rehashing shared files; subsequent calls verify bytes again. Both registered SHA and registered size, where present, are checked.

An explicit clearRights decision for a legacy upload without sha256 computes and registers the actual SHA with the human rights record and unchanged mediaRights.created event shape in one transaction. Origin is always explicit. No clearance occurs automatically.
